specName: The Hierarchical Requirement Designer in the Standalone Host
last_action: living specs evaluated — no capabilities matched

FR-001.title: Offer the designer type as Hierarchical Requirement Designer

FR-002.title: Recognise a requirement document by its envelope alone, ahead of the other .md owners

FR-003.title: Add an existing requirement document as a designer document without changing it

FR-004.title: Keep the document when its registration is deleted; create the registration with the first setting

FR-005.title: Create a new document from the binding template byte for byte

FR-006.title: One page that scrolls top to bottom, no tree beside it

FR-007.title: Items as boxes with requirements then sub-items to their right

FR-008.title: Levels that fit, a mark for those that do not, focus with a trail, not stored

FR-009.title: Number beside the title, tags below it, description under it

FR-010.title: Collapse control left of every title, kept when reopened

FR-011.title: The Knowledge designer looks in both themes, outside a table too

FR-012.title: Add without a dialog by a control and by a named key

FR-013.title: Drag an item with its content, or a requirement

FR-014.title: Confirm before deleting an entry that holds anything or is named

FR-015.title: Assessment icon at the top right, rolling up in a collapsed item

FR-016.title: The icon opens the list of its assessments to add, change, remove, resolve

FR-017.title: Typing # opens the lookup of entries of the same document

FR-018.title: Selecting a reference box shows its target without writing the file

FR-019.title: Narrow by tag, category, state and an item pattern with * and ?

FR-020.title: Sort requirements within each item without changing the file

FR-021.title: A finding stays listed under a filter and shows its entry

FR-022.title: Read an outside change again and keep what was collapsed

FR-023.title: Tell the person and offer reload or keep when unsaved edits meet an outside change

FR-024.title: Refuse an edit against a changed file, never merge

FR-025.title: Tell the person when an outside change ended the undo history

FR-026.title: Make the model change and the fixture bytes of every gesture

FR-027.title: Report each finding at its place; an unreadable file read-only, never written

FR-028.title: Read and write declared registration blocks; keep an undeclared one

FR-029.title: FBL host conformance with bullets, passing every fixture

FR-030.title: DESL host conformance with the hierarchy surface kind

FR-031.title: DED host conformance: envelope, version, never changed

FR-032.title: The hierarchy surface is shared host work, not module code
